title: Find the distinct IDs of male patients who have both normal white blood cel
question: Find the distinct IDs of male patients who have both normal white blood cell counts and normal albumin levels, and whose total cholesterol is high. Also return the average age of this group.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_058", AVG(STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('NOW')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060")) AS AvgAge
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND T2."XCL_030" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
  AND T2."XCL_031" >= 3.5
  AND T2."XCL_026" > 250
